detailed_description:
The target video is a living graphic-novel illustration in <Subject 1> with real power: ink lines stay crisp and the action hits like an anime fight scene.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>, close on his face as he roars into the microphone, electric blue light flickering across his face and the rain from energy gathering at his palm just out of frame. He drives the palm strike forward and the energy erupts: a spiraling blast of electric blue energy explodes out of his palm toward the right, a shockwave throws the rain sideways and lifts the puddle water into spray, orange sparks scatter and the street lamps flicker. On the blast the camera blows back and widens in one fast continuous pull-back, revealing his full lunge and the huge swirling vortex of energy roaring out of his hand. The camera is still pulling back as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
